description: Replace the restrictive `AsRef<[T]>` bound on the `StoreFieldIterator` blanket implementation with a more flexible `Len` trait. This will allow the iterator to work with collection types that aren't contiguous in memory and therefore don't implement `AsRef<[T]>`. The change involves extracting the `len` method into a new public trait.
functional_requirements: Create a new public `Len` trait in the reactive_stores crate that defines a single `len` method returning a `usize`.
Update the blanket implementation for `StoreFieldIterator` to require the `Len` trait instead of `AsRef<[T]>`.
Ensure the new implementation maintains the same iteration behavior and performance characteristics for existing collection types.
